_comment: Example batch config. Copy, point modelDir at your models, and list them. Run with --frames 2 first to check framing cheaply before full renders.

models._why: Tall subject — the default fill crops it through the body, so give it less height and centre it.
models.name: standing-figure

models._why: Wide and short — the width limit binds hard and renders it tiny, so let it use more width.
models.name: wide-object

models._why: Exported facing a different direction than the rest of the set. Find this with contact.js.
models.name: rotated-export
